items.title: File Einspruch against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Sie können gegen diesen Bescheid binnen zwei Wochen nach Zustellung Einspruch einlegen – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Kreis Musterland – Bußgeldstelle.
items.computation: The attached Postzustellungsurkunde (formal service, § 182 ZPO) shows 'zugestellt am 19.09.2026' (a Saturday). Formal service has no deemed-delivery fiction — the actual date on the delivery certificate is the anchor. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery (19.09.) is not counted; the two-week period (§ 43 StPO via § 46 Abs. 1 OWiG, § 67 Abs. 1 OWiG) runs from 20.09.2026 and would end Sat 03.10.2026, which is a public holiday (Tag der Deutschen Einheit) in NW (and nationwide). Under § 43 StPO the period is extended to the next working day: Monday 05.10.2026.

items.title: Pay the total fine, fee and costs
items.quote: Bitte zahlen Sie den Gesamtbetrag spätestens zwei Wochen nach Rechtskraft unter Angabe des Aktenzeichens auf das unten genannte Konto.
items.computation: Rechtskraft (finality) sets in only if no Einspruch is filed within the two-week objection period ending 05.10.2026; finality then takes effect the following day, 06.10.2026. Two weeks after that (day of Rechtskraft not counted per § 187 BGB, period ends per § 188 BGB) is Tuesday 20.10.2026, a normal working day in NW, so no further shift applies. This date assumes no Einspruch is lodged; if one is filed, Rechtskraft — and this payment deadline — do not arise on this schedule.

warnings: The payment due date (20.10.2026) is derived, not printed: it assumes the Bescheid becomes final because no Einspruch is filed by 05.10.2026; filing an Einspruch removes this payment deadline and starts a court process instead.

The letter itself is dated 15.09.2026 but was formally served (Zustellungsurkunde) only on 19.09.2026; the two-week Einspruch period is calculated from the actual service date shown on the delivery certificate, not from the letter's printed date.

Before paying, verify the IBAN (DE69 4145 0075 0000 0200 01, Sparkasse Musterland) and the Aktenzeichen match a genuine notice from Kreis Musterland – Bußgeldstelle, since Bußgeld scams sometimes imitate official fine notices.
